name: part1
hook: 284 people had to pick the human. They picked the AI.
post: Two chats at once, five minutes, one person and one AI. People picked the AI as the human 73% of the time, more often than the real person. Part 1 of 3. #ai #turingtest #chatgpt #bots #deepfake #internet #tech #psychology #thecurve

name: part2
hook: How the AI passed the Turing test
post: Turing's 1950 bar: fool people 30% of the time by 2000. In 2025 an AI hit 73%, and the trick wasn't knowing more. Part 2 of 3. #ai #turingtest #chatgpt #bots #deepfake #internet #tech #psychology #thecurve

name: part3
post: 53% of web traffic in 2025 was automated. An AI agent clicked "verify you are human". The FBI says: agree a secret word with your family. Part 3 of 3. #ai #turingtest #chatgpt #bots #deepfake #internet #tech #psychology #thecurve

name: picked
hook: They picked the AI as the human 73% of the time
post: A 2025 UC San Diego study: 284 people chatted with a person and an AI at the same time for five minutes. GPT-4.5 with a persona was picked as the human 73% of the time. #ai #turingtest #chatgpt #bots #deepfake #internet #tech #psychology #thecurve

name: persona
hook: The trick that made an AI pass as human
post: Without a persona the AI was picked as human 36% of the time. Told to act like an introverted young person into internet culture: 73%. #ai #turingtest #chatgpt #bots #deepfake #internet #tech #psychology #thecurve

name: captcha
hook: An AI clicked "I'm not a robot"
post: July 2025: an AI agent clicked Cloudflare's "Verify you are human" box. Its own note: "This step is necessary to prove I'm not a bot." #ai #turingtest #chatgpt #bots #deepfake #internet #tech #psychology #thecurve

name: secretword
hook: The FBI's advice for AI voice scams is one word
post: Voices can be copied now. The FBI's advice (Dec 2024) is low-tech: agree a secret word or phrase with your family. #ai #turingtest #chatgpt #bots #deepfake #internet #tech #psychology #thecurve
